references.text: Parallel law on killing with an iron tool - the same principle of capital punishment for intentional murder
Parallel law on killing with a wooden weapon - the same wording and principle regarding the murderer and capital punishment
Reiterates the principle that the murderer must die - the avenger of blood shall kill the murderer
Confirms capital punishment for murder, but requires witnesses
Prohibits taking ransom for a murderer's life - the death penalty must be carried out
Basic law on capital punishment for one who strikes a man to death
Whoever strikes a human being dead shall die - the same principle of retribution
Law regarding intentional murder and delivery to the avenger of blood to be killed
Fundamental principle: whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed
